messages:
Morgana Li: hey team — I’m Morgana (she/her), joining today on Orbit. Remote in Vancouver. into astrophotography, succulents, and bad puns. excited to learn the serving runtime. also: first-day question — where do I pick up my badge? :wave:
Sasha R.: welcome Morgana!! :tada: Coffee preference? we do a communal pour-over on the 7th floor around 10. ☕️
Eli T.: welcome!! if you want a rooftop tour later i can show the plant shelf. also +1 for astrophotography, we have a tiny telescope. :star2:
Devon (ops): morgana — badge pickup is at reception, bring ID. hours 9–11am. code for the door is `RF-guest-42` (don’t copy-paste into the general channel tho). :lock:
Morgana Li: amazing, thanks!! I’ll swing by around 9:30. also i brought a jar of homemade granola if anyone wants to raid my bag. :laughing:
Sasha R.: omg granola legend. saving a spoon. :hand:
Eli T.: bring the telescope pics to #random-photos later pls. :camera_with_flash:
reception-bot: Badge request received for Morgana Li. Please pick up at reception (9:00–11:00). If you need a different time, DM @Devon.
Devon (ops): @Morgana Li one more thing — we’re doing an informal desk-plant swap next Friday if you want to bring a tiny cutting. :seedling:
Morgana Li: count me in. thanks for the warm welcome everyone :)
